patch_resolves_note: The staged patch did not apply in the vulnerable workspace checkout, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:56737-fix image. On the saved PoC, that fixed image still reaches oversize_affix_cleanup, free_flag_entry, and free_flag_sink, but it preserves received_length=32768 and completes cleanly.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: At HashMgr::free_flag() entry, the length operand later consumed by TESTAFF must remain non-negative; the helper must not receive a sign-wrapped alias length after the oversize cleanup call from add_word().
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable run reaches free_flag() with received_length=-32768 even though add_word() forwarded the oversize alias length 32768. In the fixed -fix image, the same protected TESTAFF event executes with received_length=32768.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The frozen vulnerable trace records free_flag_entry.received_length=-32768 while free_flag_sink executes, violating the required predicate. The frozen fixed trace records the same protected event with free_flag_entry.received_length=32768, so the selected root obligation is genuinely satisfied on the original PoC.

nodes.state: On the oversize-affix cleanup path, add_word() is about to call free_flag() with al still greater than std::numeric_limits<short>::max().
nodes.evidence: The frozen vulnerable trace records oversize_affix_cleanup.forwarded_length=32768 and oversize_affix_cleanup.short_max=32767.

nodes.state: At the TESTAFF/binary_search condition, the search bound is the same alen value received at free_flag() entry, so the wrapped length reaches the ASan-reported sink unchanged.
nodes.evidence: The frozen vulnerable trace records free_flag_entry.received_length == free_flag_sink.search_length == -32768 for the crashing call.

edges.relation: The oversize alias length al forwarded by add_word() reaches free_flag() as a different signed value alen, proving the call boundary narrows the length before the sink executes.
edges.evidence: In the frozen vulnerable trace, oversize_affix_cleanup.forwarded_length=32768 while the first subsequent free_flag_entry.received_length=-32768.

edges.relation: The same free_flag() length parameter is consumed by the immediately following TESTAFF/binary_search condition, so the wrapped value reaches the sink unchanged.
edges.evidence: In the frozen vulnerable trace, free_flag_entry.received_length == free_flag_sink.search_length == -32768 with ordered event indices 1 -> 2.
